card.name: Spaces before numeric thresholds, and mid-drug-name pieces
card.fires_on: A space or small piece right before a number or lab threshold (increase, below, less than or equal to), and the middle of drug names like nilotinib, YORVIPATH, sevelamer hydrochloride, foscarnet.

modes.label: Space before a threshold number
modes.description: A bare space just before a lab value or percent after words like below, increase, or less than or equal to.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name, where the next piece is expected to finish it.
